name: runepilot
description: League of Legends Draft Analyzer with LCU integration and meta builds

notes.lcu: Backend uses Riot's local LCU API for match detection — personal use only per Riot policy
notes.data: Champion data from Riot Data Dragon (official CDN). Builds are community-curated meta knowledge.
notes.opgg: op.gg has no public API. We use Riot Data Dragon + curated high-elo builds instead.
